description: ANDICAM (A Novel Dual-Imaging CAMera) was an optical and infrared camera mounted on the SMARTS 1.3-meter telescope at CTIO, designed to obtain simultaneous optical and near-infrared imaging.
facility_description: Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO) is an astronomical observatory located on Cerro Tololo in Chile, operated by NSF NOIRLab.
notes: ANDICAM provided simultaneous optical and infrared imaging at the SMARTS 1.3m telescope. Filter transmission curves are hosted on OSU astronomy and NOIRLab pages without an open redistribution licence.
